marks.gloss_en: ותניא: היה יעקב אבינו בשעה שנתברך מאביו בן ששים ושלש שנה, ובו בפרק מת ישמעאל
the baraita: Jacob was sixty-three when he was blessed by his father, and at that time Ishmael died
דתניא: היה יעקב בבית עבר מוטמן ארבע עשרה שנה
rather, learn from it: the fourteen years he was in Ever's house are not counted [in the reckoning]
ומנלן דלא איענש? דתניא: נמצא יוסף שפירש מאביו עשרים ושתים שנה כשם שפירש יעקב -- the measure for measure counts only twenty-two
דיעקב תלתין ושיתא הויין! -- Jacob was away thirty-six years, not twenty-two
אלא: ארביסר דהוה בבית עבר לא חשיב להו (= p_arbesar_lo_leonesh)
the baraita: Joseph was away from his father twenty-two years, just as Jacob our father was away from his
דתניא: ... ועשה שם שמונה עשר חדש ... ובבית אל עשה ששה חדשים -- two years on the road
סוף סוף דבית לבן עשרין שנין הויין! -- even without Ever's house, Laban's was only twenty
אלא משום דאשתהי באורחא תרתין שנין (= p_ishtahi_beorcha)
rather, because he tarried two years on the road
Mar: why were Ishmael's years counted? to reckon Jacob's years by them -- 'and these are the years of the life of Ishmael, 137 years' (Gen 25:17)

(entertained) sixty-three and fourteen until Joseph is born make seventy-seven; Joseph thirty before Pharaoh (Gen 41:46) makes 107; seven of plenty and two of famine make 116 -- Jacob's age on reaching Egypt
Jacob to Pharaoh: 'the days of the years of my sojournings are 130 years' (Gen 47:9) -- against the 116 of the reckoning
one who reads the Megillah out of order has not fulfilled [his obligation]
if he read it at intervals, he has fulfilled
if it was written with sam, he has not fulfilled
ככתבם וכזמנם -- מה זמנם למפרע לא, אף כתבם למפרע לא: as the two days' times cannot come out of order, so their writing
Rava: the rule derives from 'according to their writing and according to their times' (Esth 9:27) -- as their times are not out of order, so their writing is not
מידי קריאה כתיבה הכא? עשייה כתיבה, דכתיב להיות עושים את שני הימים -- the verse speaks of DOING the days, not of reading; unanswered (the stam turns to אלא מהכא)
נזכרים ונעשים -- איתקש זכירה לעשייה: מה עשייה למפרע לא, אף זכירה למפרע לא
מידי קריאה כתיבה הכא? עשייה כתיבה -- 'according to their writing' concerns the doing of the days, not reading; unanswered: the stam replaces the source (אלא מהכא)
rather, from 'and these days are remembered and done' (Esth 9:28): remembering is juxtaposed to doing -- as doing is not out of order, so remembering
it was taught: and so [out of order, one has not fulfilled] in Hallel
Rabbah: from 'from the rising of the sun to its setting' (Ps 113:3)
Rav Avya: from 'may the name of the Lord be blessed' (Ps 113:2)
the Shema [is recited] as it is written -- Rebbi
